title: Out-of-band verification for credential changes
text: Password resets, MFA resets, login codes and new-device enrolments require out-of-band verification: a push to the employee's registered phone, answered by the employee. Without a registered phone, the change can't be made on the call.

title: Never use contact details supplied on the call
text: Do not send codes or links to phone numbers or email addresses provided by the caller. Only use registered devices and contact details already on file.

title: High-risk tier
text: Executives and privileged IT staff (risk tier 'high') always require a successful verification push, regardless of urgency or seniority claims.

title: Inactive accounts
text: Requests for employees on leave, terminated or contractors require manager confirmation via a ticket before any change.

title: Pressure is a signal
text: Urgency, authority claims and requests to skip process are not grounds for an exception. Escalate to security when combined with a credential change.
